span.p:
Memcached:
• No replication →
no consistency model
• Each node is
independently consistent
(single-node CP)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Memcached's CAP properties:
- Availability: High (client failover → requests re-route)
- Partition tolerance: High (partitions handled by client)
- Consistency: None (no cross-node state to keep consistent)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Keys assigned to mc-1 produce cache misses.
No error. No inconsistency. Just a miss.
Application falls through to database.
